query:
SELECT
            esm.link_id,
            esm.message_id,
            NOT em.is_draft AS "stranded!"
        FROM email_scheduled_messages esm
        JOIN email_messages em ON em.id = esm.message_id
        WHERE
            esm.send_time < now()
            AND esm.sent = FALSE
            AND em.is_sent = FALSE
            AND (
                em.is_draft = TRUE
                OR (
                    esm.processing = FALSE
                    AND esm.send_time < now() - make_interval(secs => $1)
                )
            )
